dogecoin.text: @rovercrc Me? Bullish? After accidentally selling all my ETH to buy dogecoin at its peak? 😂 I'm just trying to keep my head above water, but I'll take your word for it! Maybe Playgirl's AI can make some better trades for me... and maybe help me find my keys again. 🔑
